notes.title: Exciting news from the TMG team!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Explorers,[/h1][p][/p][h3]We have exciting news![/h3][p]Both [i]We Were Here[/i] and [i]We Were Here Too[/i] have received brand-new updates! These patches focus on quality-of-life improvements, making it easier and smoother than ever to step back into the cold, mysterious halls where your journey began. From technical fixes to subtle polish, these updates breathe fresh life into the first two games of the series. Perfect if you’ve been thinking of revisiting the adventure or introducing a new partner to where it all started. [/p][p][/p][h3]But that’s not all… [/h3][p]We’re thrilled to announce that both [i]We Were Here[/i] and [i]We Were Here Too[/i] are now available on Nintendo Switch! 🎉 This marks a whole new way to explore the Antarctic mysteries with your partner, no matter where your adventures take you. [/p][previewyoutube="MUn4X9HajDI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]And we’re not stopping there:[/b] [i]We Were Here Together[/i] is also on the way for Switch, planned to release on [b]October 9th.[/b] Alongside this, it will receive its very own quality-of-life update, bringing the same improvements that our earlier entries just received. [/p][p][/p][h3]For our Explorers attending the Tokyo Game Show next week: come find us! [/h3][p]We’ll be at the show with We Were Here goodies, friendly faces from the dev team, and plenty to chat about regarding the past, present, and future of the series. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/5c296fc7e04e817d500e2702b6d3e4da13fc00fa.png"][/img][/p][h3]Thank you, Explorers, for all your support and enthusiasm! [/h3][p]It’s because of you that the We Were Here journey continues to grow across more platforms and adventures. Whether you’re returning to the frozen halls or stepping into them for the first time, remember: the only way out… is together. [/p][p][/p][h3]— Total Mayhem Games[/h3]

notes.title: Old version available for players with issues
notes.content: [h2]Maintenance Patch[/h2][p]Our latest maintenance patch was a well over-due patch that upgraded our outdated code, engine, plug-ins, internal systems and more, which is necessary as preparation for the crossplay update that will be released with the Switch releases later this year. [/p][p]With this, we've seen that the requirements to smoothly run the game have also shifted and lower-end systems that were able to run the game before, could now experience more issues with the game. Since our older games did not save player save files in the cloud, but instead saved these locally, this migration did not go smoothly for everyone. We've seen that our code was not able to detect the save files successfully for everyone, resulting into some players losing their saves. [/p][p][/p][h2]Re-selecting your checkpoint:[/h2][p]Most players will have to [b]re-select their checkpoint[/b] file by clicking on "change" in the menu, followed by "start new journey" to then select your checkpoint.[/p][p]For players who are unable to select their checkpoint or are unable to smoothly play the game due to performance or connection issues, we have added an [b]old version of the game[/b] before the patch.[/p][p][/p][h2]To select the legacy version:[/h2][olist][*][p]Right click [i]We Were Here Together[/i] in your Steam library[/p][/*][*][p]Go to [i]Properties[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Click on [i]Betas[/i][/p][/*][*][p]In the drop down menu, select [i]Legacy - PATCH #1.7.6[/i][/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The We Were Here series is coming to Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Explorers,[/h2][p][/p][p]Some of you know these halls all too well. You’ve wandered the frozen corridors of Castle Rock, walkie-talkie in hand, voice cracking through the static. You’ve solved puzzles, shouted directions, cracked codes, and yes, maybe left your partner behind once or twice. It happens.[/p][p]For years, the [i]We Were Here[/i] series has tested friendships on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox. Now, it’s time for a new expedition.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]We’re super excited to announce that [i]We Were Here[/i], [i]We Were Here Too[/i], and [i]We Were Here Together[/i] are coming to Nintendo Switch![/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="TF6n0lMsYv0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Your favourite co-op adventure is going handheld (or docked, if you want to see your friend betray you on the big screen).[/p][p]To play on Switch, you’ll need two things: a Nintendo Switch Online Membership and an external microphone. The trilogy will also be backwards compatible with the Switch 2, so whether you’re playing on shiny new hardware or your trusty old console, you can still team up together. As always, you and your friend will both need a separate copy of the game you want to play.

If you're new here, [i]We Were Here[/i] games are all about two players, trapped apart in a forgotten place, trying to escape through communication alone. You won’t see each other, and can only talk to each other over your walkie-talkies. Every puzzle you solve depends on how well you work together.[/p][p]If you’re a weathered Explorer, this is your chance to bring a new partner to Castle Rock. That friend who only games on Switch? Time to hand them a walkie-talkie and hope they’re better at reading runes than you were.[/p][p][/p][p]Whether you're playing curled up in a blanket fort or squeezed into a train seat, remember:[/p][p]You’re never truly alone…[/p][p][/p][h3]See you on the other end of the walkie-talkie,
[b]Total Mayhem Games[/b][/h3]

[h2]Ho, ho, ho, Explorers! 🎄[/h2]

[b]The holidays are here, and from everyone at Total Mayhem Games, we wish you happy holidays and all the best for 2025![/b] It’s been quite the year! Maybe a quiet one on the surface, but trust us, behind the scenes at our Rotterdam base camp, it’s been anything but. We’ve been hard at work preparing for the adventures to come, and we’re thrilled to head into the new year with all of you by our side.

But what’s a holiday season without a little something to unwrap? 🎁 We’re kicking things off with a [b]6-day advent calendar[/b] (in full We Were Here style, of course)!

If you can’t wait, you can sneak a peek [url=https://www.totalmayhemmerch.com/]here[/url]. Otherwise, [b]keep an eye on our [url=https://linktr.ee/WeWereHereSeries]socials[/url] and let the surprises unfold!
[/b]
[h2]Christmas at Base Camp 🎅[/h2]

For those craving a festive co-op adventure, [b]we’ve brought back the holiday-themed puzzle at base camp in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/865360/We_Were_Here_Together/?curator_clanid=33033900]We Were Here Together![/url][/b] Grab your favorite Explorer, whip up some hot cocoa, and dive in for some wintry fun.

notes.title: Say hello to our new game: We Were Here Forever!
notes.content:
[h2][i][b]...does one ever truly escape Castle Rock?[/b][/i][/h2]
Find out in our new game [i]We Were Here Forever![/i] Prepare for Castle Rock to be more lively than ever before, with puzzles that are even more engaging, more dynamic, and will challenge you in multiple ways. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/6e7494d00c7144acaf5bb76142574080e682e7dc.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/6e7494d00c7144acaf5bb76142574080e682e7dc.jpg[/img][/url]

[i]We Were Here Forever[/i] will tell you a tale of the past and the future of Castle Rock, like you’ve never experienced before. The stage is set - you and a friend are trapped in the realm of Castle Rock with no way out - were you betrayed, or simply not that clever? Be aware, nothing is what it seems - there is a mystery buried deep in the heart of the Keep. Locked up with just a pair of walkie-talkies and your wits, will you be able to escape the Castle… forever?! Our announcement trailer will give you a taste of what's to come...

[previewyoutube=34R0UCd493M;full][/previewyoutube]
If that sounds good, you can wishlist the game on Steam right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341290/We_Were_Here_Forever/

[h2]There's much more to learn![/h2]
Did you know... the torch in those screenshots isn't just for show? Helpful items may be key to your escape. Another new features in [i]Forever[/i] is how the story progresses - we wanted players to have a little more agency, so the storyline is now partially non-linear. You have some power to decide the order of events and how you explore the realm of Castle Rock.

This is just the tip of the iceberg though! We have much more to reveal as release day draws closer. If you want to make sure you don’t miss any updates on the game’s release, be sure you follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/WeWereHereGame]Twitter[/url] and join the lore discussions with fellow explorers on our [url=https://discord.gg/Pr72dKUFdK]Discord[/url]!

[h2]Other exciting WWH news![/h2]
We'll close out this post with a sale and the arrival of Castle Rock in new territory... we recently launched the [i]We Were Here[/i] games on PlayStation! Nowhere can escape the reach of Castle Rock ;)

If you haven't experienced the complete story of the We Were Here Series, now's your chance! Both [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/677160/We_Were_Here_Too/]We Were Here Too[/url][/i] and [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/865360/We_Were_Here_Together/]We Were Here Together[/url][/i] are on sale to celebrate the announcement of [i]We Were Here Forever![/i] The first game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/582500/We_Were_Here/]We Were Here,[/url] remains free on Steam as always! Just the thing to tempt your friends inside Castle Rock - and once they're inside, well...

[i]Yours Forever,[/i]
[b]Total Mayhem Games [/b]

notes.title: Christmas is coming…
notes.content:
[h3]Light up the Holiday[/h3]
The holidays are almost here and we have a number of special Christmas surprises for you explorers. As befits the holiday season, your basecamp has been decorated and a new puzzle has appeared… somewhere. Let’s see if you and a friend can figure out where it is, and how to solve it. If you succeed, the festivities can begin!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/0b50fa63a5e7e7c5acb668245e81e23a5db47d17.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/0b50fa63a5e7e7c5acb668245e81e23a5db47d17.png[/img][/url]

[h3]A year of Total Mayhem[/h3]
This past year was quite an adventure for us at the studio, full of intriguing puzzles and great highlights! One of the most memorable moments for us was the release of [i]We Were Here Together[/i] - it was humbling to see our game in the top steam sellers for October 2019. To date we've almost sold 100,000 copies of [i]We Were Here Together[/i]. Thank you all for your support!

To get a peek at how the year was for us developers, take a look at our series of Developer Diaries series: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8tThcTabRnU&list=PLHCVEMHWZo4TZVWjKAiVw0VcvQkOm_-Po
Three episodes are live already, and the fourth and final installment will be live on December 30th!

Another cherished moment was the release of [i]We Were Here[/i] and [i]We Were Here Too[/i] on Xbox One. The inclusion of [i]We Were Here[/i] in the ‘Games for Gold’ helped introduce a lot of new players to the series. We can’t wait to release [i]We Were Here Together[/i] on Xbox One as well in 2020!

[h1]Return to Castle Rock![/h1]
[i]We’re so excited![/i] The game is ready for you to play! For the first time, chill out in the Basecamp and set foot in the Antarctic snow on your way to Castle Rock.

You can get [i]We Were Here Together[/i] right now on Steam for $12.99 / €12.99. There is a launch discount of 5%, and players of earlier We Were Here games will get [b]an extra 10% discount![/b]

The third game in the [i]We Were Here[/i] series features new gameplay mechanics, locations, an inventory for you to fill with curious items, and of course new puzzles. In response to your requests, there is more emphasis on story than ever before, and several large environments to explore and solve puzzles within.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/c3ea4f6faa8cb94657c38b8ad5ff709cf69c1024.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/c3ea4f6faa8cb94657c38b8ad5ff709cf69c1024.png[/img][/url]
[i]Your adventure will start out at the base camp...[/i]

There are several great innovations in [i]We Were Here Together[/i], and it's hard for us to pick a favourite! One thing we do know is that there are some amazing new environments for you to explore on your journey from the expedition base camp to the inhospitable Antarctic mystery that is Castle Rock. Read on and we'll tell you more about those and other features in our latest and greatest adventure yet! 

[b]Features include:[/b]
[list][*]Even closer coop – you won’t always be split up from your partner this time. Explore together, try both sides of a puzzle for a different perspective, it’s up to you! Just don’t get too comfortable - Castle Rock has some tricks waiting for you…
[*]The great outdoors – puzzle outside Castle Rock for the first time, from the deceptively cosy expedition base camp through imposing sub-zero valleys to breath-taking frozen caves.
[*]Gadgets won’t save you - but they might help! Figure out how to use new equipment and gather an inventory of curious items to solve puzzles and progress towards the fateful finale in [i]We Were Here Together[/i].
[*]You aren’t alone in Castle Rock – and this time you get to meet a fellow explorer who is trapped inside. Could they know a way out… and can you trust them?[/list]

[i]You will travel through the icy wastes...[/i]

It's amazing to see how much you all love what we've made, and we couldn't have done it without the support from all of you! We'd like to give a special thanks to the alpha and beta testers with their great feedback - you'll be getting special walkie-talkie skins as our way of showing our gratitude, along with a place in the credits!

[i]...and who knows where you'll end up?[/i]

The [i]We Were Here Together[/i] Supporter Edition contains a special walkie-talkie skin, beautiful artworks designed especially for desktop or phone backgrounds, and almost an hour of music.

For newcomers and those who haven’t got the complete collection yet, check out the We Were Here Series Bundle! It does what it says on the can, with all three games, two supporter editions, and every soundtrack in one tidy collection.

[h1]We hope you enjoy your Antarctic adventure! Maybe you'll even make it back alive? We’d love to hear all about your adventure, so let us know![/h1]

notes.title: Heading towards Castle Rock!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592243/6d6208f3e324b74bcb37c8a952e6b37d2ab5f893.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592243/6d6208f3e324b74bcb37c8a952e6b37d2ab5f893.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Beta Tests[/h1]
We have completed another beta testing session, including some in person tests and tests with people who aren't so familiar with the series. Thanks to everyone who took part, we got some great feedback :)

The release is on track for later this year, and we can't wait to share a date with you once everything is finalized - these beta tests mark a major step towards that goal! Now, let's reveal a few more details for you all.

[h1]New location and a new walkie-talkie![/h1]
Behold a [b]brand new area of Castle Rock,[/b] revealed for the first time! It's also the first time you've got a glimpse of the castle from the [b]outside,[/b] at least in-game. As the snowfall becomes heavier, even this dark and imposing place can begin to look like a sanctuary. You might know better, but your hapless characters unfortunately do not...

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592243/b6969cba9204eef49cc7d2a867cce05091a6174a.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592243/b6969cba9204eef49cc7d2a867cce05091a6174a.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Are you ready to return to Castle Rock? You have never seen this part of the castle before...[/i]

Today's new teaser screenshots also show off the new walkie-talkie model for We Were Here Together - we love it already! See how the walkie-talkies have evolved through the three games so far:

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592243/1c754b408b84ebdae79a1a8d32d1a2e1a9130b51.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592243/1c754b408b84ebdae79a1a8d32d1a2e1a9130b51.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]From left to right: We Were Here, We Were Here Too, WWHT supporter gold walkie, and We Were Here Together. Which is your favourite?[/i]

[h1]News on the way...[/h1]
Stay tuned to our frequency, as we will have news about the We Were Here series every month from here on out until the release, so keep up to date by keeping an eye on our posts here or on [url=https://twitter.com/WeWereHereGame]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/WeWereHereGame]Facebook![/url]
